description.value: The Aegir Room is a hip, full-service restaurant situated within the Oswego Hotel in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, serving the local community as well as hotel guests. The menu leans toward fresh Pacific seafood with a notable happy hour, and the kitchen offers a broad range of options including gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan dishes. Weekly themed nights — Prime Rib Sundays with live music, Burger & Beer Wednesdays, and Pasta Thursdays — give touring cyclists a reason to time a visit.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at aegirroom.ca confirms this is a real, operating restaurant inside the Oswego Hotel at 500 Oswego St, Victoria BC, with phone (250) 410-2085 matching OSM. The site lists full menus including gluten-free and vegan options, and the happy hour menu explicitly notes 'All of our fryer items are gluten-free' and offers vegan-available dishes. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or takeout appears on the site, though the dine-in focus is noted on the happy hour page.
concerns: OSM lists no website tag directly; URL was discovered externally with high confidence. The OSM record provides only a website:menu tag pointing to the Oswego Hotel site, while the discovered URL aegirroom.ca appears to be the restaurant's own standalone site — both are consistent with the same business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating restaurant in James Bay, Victoria with a confirmed active website, matching contact details, and full menus — useful to any touring cyclist seeking a sit-down meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Happy hour menu notes 'All of our fryer items are gluten-free' and lists individual dishes tagged GF, DF, and 'Vegan Available' (e.g. Aegir Chicken Bites with crispy tofu option)

wow_evidence: full-service restaurant situated within the Oswego Hotel

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: hotel Pacific seafood, happy-hour apps $18-19, mains ~$30-45; ~$32-48pp
